decode.scroll_stop_trick: A big 'Problem? Try us.' headline next to the product, and three circles stacked on the right — red ring, yellow ring, green ring — showing the same body part across three months, with a crossed-out price and a green SHOP NOW. The traffic-light rings do the convincing.
decode.angle_carried: 'Flat but flabby? Try YOLO.' — Adrien's final 'Beer Belly? Try WILDHORN.' (Loom 2: 'perfect')
decode.hidden_reading: the three rings are a scorecard; red → green reads as 'solved' before any claim is read; the deal closes it
decode.scene_logic: left: headline over the product; right: three circles JULY / AUGUST / SEPTEMBER; bottom: SPECIAL DEAL, price, button; ours identical with calves and ankles in the circles
decode.visual_trick: the ring colours red → yellow → green and the crossed-out price; copy literally
decode.shape_or_function_equivalent: two tubs + scattered gummies ↔ one pouch + a clear glass with the tablet fizzing and two white effervescent tablets on the surface; waist crops ↔ calf/ankle crops in profile
decode.render_style: deep navy background, bright white type, product with a soft spotlight, photo crops in coloured rings
decode.text_treatment: huge white bold headline 3 lines, month labels white caps, red 'SPECIAL DEAL' tag, big price with crossed old price, green rounded button with arrow

strategy.angle: A8-L swollen legs on an otherwise slim body — 'Swollen legs? Try Edenvia.'
strategy.mechanism: M1: when the body can't clear everyday oxidative stress, the tissue in the legs stays inflamed and stops draining normally, so fluid sits there — heavy, tender, puffy — and no diet reaches it, because it was never fat; the tablet turns a glass of water into hydrogen-rich water, hydrogen is the smallest molecule there is, reaches the tissue and helps the body switch that process off so normal drainage can resume
strategy.sub_avatar: trigger: slim everywhere except the calves and ankles · cause: inflamed tissue holding fluid · tried: diets that made her thinner but not less swollen
strategy.belief_installed: It was never fat. It's fluid my body stopped clearing — and no diet reaches it.
